title: Statue of Unity, Kevadia
summary: The Statue of Unity near Kevadia in Gujarat honours Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. Construction began in October 2013 and the statue was inaugurated on 31 October 2018. The Ministry of Tourism's Incredible India page gives its height as 182 m, and L&T says it was built in 33 months.

uncertainty.note: Start is the start of construction (October 2013); the statue was inaugurated on 31 October 2018. End is the present.

as_recorded.value: On 31 October 2018 the statue was inaugurated
The SoU was inaugurated by PM Modi on 31st October 2018.
